description: DSv4-Flash on the pulsar ds4 engine, serveable TODAY: routed-expert tensors run ONLY on CUTLASS_MXFP4 (40) or IQ2_XXS_MMQ (43); attention, shared-expert and dense tensors run ONLY on the FP8 tensor-core path (MXFP8_E4M3 group-32); the token embedding and the output head are plain bf16 (a deliberate fidelity choice). IQ2_XXS and MXFP4 are the allocator-facing identities; the artifact stores their pre-formatted twins IQ2_XXS_MMQ (43) and CUTLASS_MXFP4 (40), which are pure layout permutations at identical bits and therefore allocation-equivalent. gate and up must match; gate/up and down are independently one of the two, and the combo may differ per layer.

export_lane.exporter: pulsar gguf-tools/deepseek4-quantize (out of tree; per-tensor --format-map JSON)
export_lane.detail: pulsar's quantizer writes exactly the formats its engine has kernels for; the declaration module mirrors its format-map vocabulary

format_rules.detail: routed-expert tensors: the only surviving expert kernels are CUTLASS_MXFP4 (type 40, CUTLASS grouped tensor-core) and IQ2_XXS_MMQ (types 43/44, MMQ arms) -- verified against weights.cpp:tensor_is_routed_expert_type. Q2_K and the other IQ2/IQ3 expert types have no kernel; pricing Q2_K here yields an artifact the engine refuses at load.
token embedding and output head are shipped as plain bf16 (source-exact); the engine has no quantized path for them
attention / shared-expert / dense projections are served only on the FP8 tensor-core path (MXFP8_E4M3 group-32); no IQ/k-quant kernels exist for them

shape_rules.detail: GGUF k-quants and 256-superblock IQ types pack 256-element superblocks along the input dim
OCP MX formats scale 32-element groups (E8M0 per-group scale) along the input dim
